title: Derive the acceptance basis once per read snapshot instead of walking history repeatedly per show or evaluation
outcome: Derive the acceptance basis once per read snapshot instead of walking history repeatedly per show or evaluation
acceptance: One show or evaluation read derives each item's acceptance basis at most once per read snapshot and reuses it, instead of repeating the acceptance-basis history walk for each check (src/storage/work/query/canonical.rs and judgment_is_current)
A behaviour test on an item with many distinct planning revisions shows the work done by one read grows with the item's revisions, not with revisions times checks
